Run tests with `env -u CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_URL -u CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_TOKEN .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --no-cov <files>`. No network, no live model call, no billed call: every Jev and narration call in a test is a stub. Do not git commit. NEVER print or write any credential. NO regular expressions in new code. Never name a story, a character, an item or a scene id in engine code under storygame/ (scripts and tests may name them). Keep the code in the style of the surrounding file (comment density, naming, idiom). Before you finish run `.venv/bin/python -m ruff format <every file you changed>` and `.venv/bin/python -m ruff check <the same files>`; the check fails on unformatted files. METHOD for code tasks: write the new tests FIRST and run them to see them fail for the right reason, then implement until they pass. BACKGROUND. Every enforced observation run so far used scene 1A (drawer, truck, passenger seat, laptop) of data/stories/continuity-initiative. The T9h preregistration (.plans/grounded-llm-environment-narration/t9h-confirmation-prereg.md, read it; its text is the contract, this brief is the part you own) measures enforcement on targets and scenes not yet seen. It adds three routes, a supporter underside probe, per-route gates G1 to G10 and a stage script. This build is free and offline. ROUTE NAMES AND COMMANDS (shared by all tasks; ROUTES keys in scripts/ringer/transcript_1a/live_baseline.py): `observe_supporters_1a` (scene 1A): inspect the workstation / search the workstation / look under the workstation / examine the workstation chair / check the workstation chair / look under the workstation chair. `observe_park_bench_1b` (scene 1B): inspect the park bench / look under the park bench / search the park bench / check the park bench / look under the park bench / inspect the storm drain. `observe_executive_desk_3b` (scene 3B): inspect the executive desk / search the executive desk / look under the executive desk / examine the executive desk / check the executive desk / look under the executive desk. The existing route `observe_look_inside_under` (route C, scene 1A drawer) is the regression route and stays unchanged. You own ONLY these NEW files in scripts/ringer/environment_narration/: enforce_t9h.sh, make_t9h_run_manifests.py, make_t9h_probe_run_manifest.py, run-t9h-smoke.json, run-t9h-full.json, run-t9h-probe-live.json, plus the NEW test file tests/test_t9h_run_manifests.py. Never edit an existing file. READ FIRST, copy their structure exactly: enforce_t9e.sh, make_t9e_run_manifests.py, make_t9e_probe_run_manifest.py (or make_t9b_probe2_run_manifest.py for the under_question_probe), tests/test_t9e_run_manifests.py, and 'Stages S and F' and 'Stage P' in .plans/grounded-llm-environment-narration/t9h-confirmation-prereg.md. BUILD. (1) enforce_t9h.sh smoke|full: routes in this order, each its own worker run, each only if the previous route's summary has stopped_reason null: `observe_look_inside_under` (c), `observe_supporters_1a` (d), `observe_park_bench_1b` (e), `observe_executive_desk_3b` (f). Port 8798. Output `bench/results/environment-narration/t9h/$STAGE/{c,d,e,f}/rows`. Caps. smoke: c `--replicates 1 --max-calls 50`, d, e, f each `--replicates 2 --max-calls 90`, MAX_USD 0.07. full: c `--replicates 5 --max-calls 250`, d, e, f each `--replicates 10 --max-calls 450`, MAX_USD 0.45. All other behaviour as enforce_t9e.sh (env loading, credentials unset, port-in-use refusal exit 4, worker start check exit 3, spent file, kill and wait). (2) make_t9h_run_manifests.py writes run-t9h-smoke.json and run-t9h-full.json: one Ringer task each, with a check that asserts the spent cap, per route rows.json and summary.json exist with the right replicate and turn counts when the route did not stop (turns: c 6, d 6, e 6, f 6; last input `look under the drawer`, `look under the workstation chair`, `inspect the storm drain`, `look under the executive desk`), `enforce` is true, every turn has the field `call_timings` in addition to the T9e fields, and no credential value appears in any output file; and a task note that the runner must wait for the billed process. (3) make_t9h_probe_run_manifest.py writes run-t9h-probe-live.json for `under_question_probe.py --corpus v4` with `--max-calls 48 --max-usd 0.01`, output `bench/results/environment-narration/t9h/probe/`, a check on the row count (48 requests, or a stop reason) and the credential-leak check. TESTS (new file): the three JSON files equal what the generators write; the script has the four routes in order, the port and caps above; the checks contain the turn counts and last inputs; no manifest contains a credential value; `bash -n enforce_t9h.sh` passes. Do not run the script and do not start any worker.
